title: New trees are sprouting up across San Diego!
description:
New trees are sprouting up across San Diego! In fact, the City planted more than 5,000 trees in 2025, and more than 14,000 since 2020. 🌳

Trees provide shade and help cool our neighborhoods, clean the air, support wildlife and reduce climate pollution. Many of these new trees were planted through the grant-funded Ready, Set, Grow San Diego initiative, which focused planting efforts in City Heights, Bay Terraces, Linda Vista, Oak Park, Otay Mesa-Nestor, Paradise Hills and Encanto. 

While the planting phase of this initiative is now complete, the work continues with protecting existing trees and redesigning sidewalks to support long-term tree health. 

#SDClimateWeek #UrbanForestry #ClimateAction
